summary: Implemented every stub in src/marshmallow/schema.py: metaclass field collection and hook resolution, from_dict, the dump/dumps/load/loads/validate pipeline, nested only/exclude normalization, _init_fields and _bind_field, plus the missing processor and validator helpers and the dict_class property. The last full-suite run showed 1214 passed and 15 failed; the remaining failures are in fields.py (Dict, IP, Decimal, date/time format, Pluck data_key) and a package-metadata test, none in schema.py.
